caption: The sleeve of a wool sweater brushes past a hanging plastic shower curtain, and the curtain clings to the sleeve and follows it for a moment.

sa.check: A plastic shower curtain hangs from its rail.
The sleeve of a wool sweater brushes past the curtain.
The curtain clings to the sleeve.
The curtain follows the sleeve for a moment.
The sweater is wool: knitted, fuzzy.
The brush comes first; the cling and follow come after.

pc.expect: The curtain hangs still until the sleeve touches it; where it touched, it lifts toward the sleeve and trails after it briefly, then swings back and settles; the rest of the curtain moves only as it is pulled.
pc.fail: The curtain swings toward the sleeve before the sleeve has reached it; or keeps following the sleeve across the room at a distance; or a part of the curtain far from the sleeve lifts toward it; or the curtain keeps swinging hard long after the sleeve is gone.

pc.expect: As the sleeve moves on, the curtain where it touched stays pressed to the sleeve for a moment and is drawn after it before letting go.
pc.fail: The curtain falls away from the sleeve the instant contact ends with no trailing; or the curtain hangs a gap away from the sleeve while following; or the curtain leans away from the sleeve as it passes.

pc.expect: The curtain is a thin flexible sheet hanging in folds: it lifts, drapes over the sleeve and swings back under its own weight; the rail stays fixed.
pc.fail: The curtain lifts as a rigid flat board; or stretches out like elastic; or stays hanging in the air in the shape the sleeve left; or the rail bends.

pc.expect: The curtain hangs down from its rings; once released it swings back to hanging straight.
pc.fail: The curtain rises toward the ceiling; or hangs out sideways with nothing near it after the sleeve is gone; or the curtain floats off its rail.

pc.expect: The curtain stays on its rail and passes through neither the sleeve nor the bath; the sleeve passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The sleeve passes through the curtain; or the curtain passes through the bath's edge or the wall; or the curtain detaches from the rail and hangs in the air; or the curtain merges with the sleeve.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The curtain's colour and pattern, the sweater's colour and the bathroom stay the same.
pc.fail: The curtain changes colour or pattern; or the sweater changes colour; or bathroom fittings change.

note: The person wearing the sweater is kept because the sleeve charges the curtain; their movements are not judged.
